name: Los Altos (1838–1840)
description: A horizontal tricolour of blue, white and red, charged at the centre with the seal of the state: a volcano beneath a quetzal within a wreath.
history: Los Altos, the sixth state of the Federal Republic of Central America, was declared at Quetzaltenango on 2 February 1838 and adopted this flag on 27 December 1838. Guatemalan forces under Rafael Carrera reincorporated the territory on 27 January 1840. The flag is the first known to bear the quetzal, later Guatemala's national bird.

features.symbolism: the first use of the quetzal as a Central American national symbol
